summary: Tantech Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on September 21, 2026, Nasdaq notified the Company it had regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The Company had received a deficiency letter on March 26, 2026, after its Class A common shares closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, triggering a 180-day cure period ending September 22, 2026. Nasdaq confirmed the bid price stayed at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days, September 4 through September 18, 2026, closing the matter. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The listing overhang is removed; watch for renewed sub-$1 pressure or future deficiency notices.
